retained_results: Opaque card failure is fixed and all clean frames are empty.
Flight is now body-contacting and approximately 0.75 body length; retain its core placement and overall envelope.
The Unity body is technically intact and materially more readable than R2; preserve the frozen normalized FBX and all GUIDs.
visual_blockers: Muzzle ignition is a soft oval with one pointed tail, while peak and near-peak collapse into two or three straight prongs. The sequence reads as a line-star/needle effect rather than a layered fire ignition.
Flight has the correct attachment and length but remains a clean spear/beam with hard straight edges; it needs a broken flame contour without changing the accepted envelope.
Impact peak is dominated by five straight radial prongs. This directly violates the no-line-star requirement and is visibly below the supplied school fire and commercial floor.
Impact decay is effectively invisible at 0.440 seconds, so there is no readable soot/ember tail.
Unity body panels and brass braces remain flatter and darker than the approved Blender R11 comparison, particularly on the top strap and front frame.

preserve: 83 renderer hierarchy, eight remaps and all prefab GUIDs
r4_constraints.body_material: Raise only the top strap, machined frame and copper-brace readability toward the approved Blender R11 comparison. Do not alter geometry or turn the black shell gray.
r4_constraints.muzzle: Use a coherent 3-to-5-lobe fire mass with a short directional base, warm outer contour and compact white-yellow core. Peak and near-peak must retain curved/lobed silhouettes; remove every straight radial prong.
r4_constraints.flight: Keep contact and length but break the spear edges with two overlapping curved outer lobes, one shorter offset tongue and a sparse soot shoulder. No beam, needle or symmetric cone read.
r4_constraints.impact: Replace the radial prongs with a broad 3-to-5-lobe asymmetrical fireball, two or three short curved fragments and a visible brown-red soot/ember decay at 0.44 seconds. Decay must be readable without becoming a residue card.
r4_constraints.capture: Repeat all R3 original-resolution body/M/F/I/comparison/clean frames plus one closer impact-decay macro and rerun 30-cycle.

forbidden: line stars or straight radial prongs
